name: Deterministic Integer Allocation
definition: A deterministic method to convert expected Gaussian counts $B p_n$ into integer allocations $k_n^ ullet$ for $N$ anchors, ensuring the total count sums exactly to budget $B$ without sorting or ties.
summary: Deterministic Integer Allocation converts continuous probabilities into integer counts summing to a budget using fixed-phase rounding, offering a deterministic, tie-free, and efficient alternative to stochastic sampling.
